purpose: Checklist 4.1: HF bench of R0 (Nemotron-Parse v1.1 full SFT, step 299) vs its base, same protocol; memory is publishable, speed is not (BUG-001)

verdict.memory: publishable: fine-tuning adds ~0.3 GB steady (3.87 vs 3.58 GB)
verdict.speed: NOT publishable: the R0 export decodes at ~3x the per-token cost of the base. Both runs load the HF remote-code class (hf_nemotron_parse_modeling), which supports the KV cache (the base is linear to 1024 tokens), but the export writes use_cache=false (ckpt_complete.EXPORT_OWNED_GENERATION_KEYS, the BUG-001 workaround needed only by the native AutoModel class). Re-measure with this protocol once the export stops forcing it for the HF class

caveats: the base is not trained for CORD: 2/30 requests emit 1 token and 3/30 hit 1024 tokens, so its tok/s mixes very different lengths
one run each, shared GPU host
